name: 腾讯自选股·智能选股
description_zh: 把用自然语言描述的选股逻辑（如"连续放量上涨的题材股""低估值高股息蓝筹"）转化为可执行的多指标/多策略扫描条件，在全市场范围内批量筛选，输出符合条件的候选股票池。
description_en: Convert stock selection logic described in natural language (such as "thematic stocks rising on sustained high trading volume" or "undervalued, high-dividend blue-chip stocks") into executable scanning criteria based on multiple indicators or strategies; then, perform a batch screen across the entire market to generate a pool of candidate stocks that meet these criteria.
